questions.question: Describe the key differences between assimilation and multiculturalism as approaches to social change. (2 × 10 = 20) END OF THE QUESTION PAPER ***
questions.solution_html:
• Describe the key difference between assimilation and multiculturalism as approaches to social
  • change.
  • Key Differences
  • Feature Assimilation Multiculturalism
  • Focus Uniformity and conformity Diversity and coexistence
  • Cultural Approach Dominance of one culture Recognition of multiple cultures
  • Integration Minority adapts to majority culture Mutual respect and shared adaptation
  • Identity Outcome Loss of minority cultural identity Preservation of cultural identities
  • Practical Example
  • • Assimilation: Immigrants are required to abandon their native languages and customs in favor
  • of the dominant language and cultural practices of their new country.
  • • Multiculturalism: Immigrants are encouraged to celebrate their cultural heritage, while also
  • participating in the broader societal framework, such as through bilingual education and
  • cultural festivals.
  • (U) (5)
